articles.summary: OneWater Marine Inc. (NASDAQ: ONEW) (the “Company” or “OneWater”) announced today that it will release its fourth quarter and full-year 2026 financial results on Tuesday, November 17 th , 2026, before the market opens. OneWater Marine will offer a live webcast of the conference call, accessible from the Investor Relations section of the company's website, at https://investor.onewatermarine.com/ where it will be archived for one year. articles.summary: Increases Floor Plan Capacity by $50 Million with New Lender Joining Syndicate OneWater Marine Inc. (NASDAQ: ONEW) (“OneWater” or the “Company”) today announced that it has amended its senior secured term loan and floor plan financing facilities to extend both maturities by two years and increase floor plan capacity by $50 million. Key terms: Term loan maturity extended by two years to July 31, 2029 Floor plan maturity extended by two years to March 1, 2029 Floor plan inventory financing capacity increased by $50 million to up to $547 million “Extending maturities for both facilities and expanding our floor plan capacity reflect our progress in strengthening our balance sheet and the continued support of our lending partners. The amendments give us added flexibility to effectively manage our inventory as we navigate this challenging retail environment.
